programs.title: My Cat From Hell: Posey the Terror
programs.desc: Jackson experiences the vicious claws of a troubled cat terrorizing a family about to bring home a newborn baby  Jackson meets an inspirational cat named Skinny  Cole and Marmalade.

programs.title: I Was Prey: Wicked Bite
programs.desc: Jim Lane picks blueberries alone in the Blue Ridge Mountains until a timber rattlesnake attacks  teacher Rachael Lilienthal's swim in a Florida river becomes a struggle when an alligator bites down on her arm, pulls her underwater and doesn't let go.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Oscar the Grouchy Frogmouth
programs.desc: Terri returns to her hometown in Oregon to help Brady, a cougar in need of a vital health check  at the zoo, Robert is on a mission to rescue Oscar, a small bird with a big attitude  Bindi bathes an echidna with bad skin allergies.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Out on a Limb
programs.desc: Tom must navigate a sloping tree to rescue a difficult cat  Shaun faces wet and damp conditions to save a friendly, homesick stray.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: Elephant Country
programs.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers that has been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programs.title: Tiffany Haddish Does Shark Week
programs.desc: Tiffany Haddish's fantasy is to uncover the secrets of shark sex, sailing on the fanciest yachts surrounded by friendly sea creatures and pampered by a handsome merman.
